GEOGRAPHY — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.
   B. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.
   D. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.
   C. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

4. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.
   C. Treat Weathering as rumours only.
   D. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weather as rumours only.
   B. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.

6. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Climate as rumours only.
   C. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.

7. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   D. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Soils as rumours only.
   B. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.
   D. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   B. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   C. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

12. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.
   B. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.
   D. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.
   B. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.
   D. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.

15. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

16. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Tourism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Transport and Communication and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Climate and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
